app.name: Nitean Studio
projects.title: Projects
projects.empty.title: No projects yet
projects.empty.body: Start with a topic — the app writes a scene-by-scene script you can edit.
projects.presetsHint: Start a new project in this style
projects.sample.title: Real-world Tech Explainer sample
projects.sample.body: A finished video can mix licensed photos with diagrams and code scenes.
projects.sample.photoAlt: A technician working at a server rack
projects.sample.diagramAlt: A process diagram with Khmer labels
projects.sample.codeAlt: A dark terminal card showing a traceroute command
projects.sample.photoCredit: Photo by Derrick Coetzee, CC0 via Wikimedia Commons.
projects.deleteBody: The project and all its generated files will be removed from this computer. This can't be undone.
projects.noKey: Add your Gemini API key in Settings before generating a script.
wizard.title: New project
wizard.topic.label: What is the video about?
wizard.topic.placeholder: e.g. Where did rice come from?
wizard.topic.example1: តើស្រូវកើតមកពីណា?
wizard.language.label: Narration language
wizard.length.label: Target length
wizard.aspect.label: Aspect ratio
wizard.style.label: Visual style
wizard.noKey: No API key yet — the project will be created, and you can generate the script after adding a key in Settings.
script.regenerateBody: All scenes and your edits will be replaced by a new script.
script.approvedBody: Voices are generated on the Scenes page. Editing the script stops voice generation; scenes whose text changes get a new voice.
script.empty.title: No script yet
script.empty.body: Generate a scene-by-scene script from the topic. Nothing else is generated until you approve it.
script.copiedForReview: Script copied — paste it into ChatGPT or Gemini to check it.
script.pasteHint: Copy the script, check it in ChatGPT/Gemini, then paste the full corrected script here. The app formats Scene/Narration/Spoken blocks automatically; Markdown and Khmer labels are accepted.
script.pasteMissingFields: Scene {n} has no Narration or Spoken text.
script.pasteParseFailed: No scenes found. Copy the script with Copy full script and keep the format: Scene 1, Narration: …, Spoken: …
script.pasteNoChanges: No changes — the script already matches.
script.narrationHint: Shown as subtitles. One or two short sentences.
script.spokenHint: Read by the voice. Numbers, years and foreign names written out as they are spoken.
script.imagePromptHint: Describe only what is in the picture — the style is added automatically. No text in images.
script.selectScene: Select a scene to edit it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.key.title: Gemini API key
settings.key.body: Your own key from Google AI Studio. It is stored only in Windows Credential Manager — never in project files or logs.
settings.key.clearBody: You'll need to paste it again before generating anything.
settings.language.title: Interface language
settings.language.body: Khmer is used automatically when Windows is set to Khmer.
settings.theme.title: Appearance
settings.theme.body: Light or dark colours. "Same as Windows" follows the Windows app mode.
settings.output.title: Output folder
settings.models.title: Models
settings.models.body: Gemini model IDs. Change only if a model is renamed or retired.
settings.about.title: About
settings.about.body: Nitean Studio — narrated explainer videos in Khmer or English.
update.title: Nitean Studio {version} is available
update.noNotes: No release notes for this version.
update.installing: Installing — Nitean Studio will close and open again.
update.warnJobs: Finish or pause running generations and exports first. Anything still running stops and can be resumed after the restart. Your projects and settings are kept.
update.error: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
retry.busy: Google is busy, retrying… (model {model}, attempt {attempt}/{max}, in {seconds} s)
retry.rate_limited: Too many requests, retrying… (model {model}, attempt {attempt}/{max}, in {seconds} s)
retry.network: Connection problem, retrying… (model {model}, attempt {attempt}/{max}, in {seconds} s)
error.missing_key.title: No API key yet
error.missing_key.body: Add your Gemini API key in Settings, then try again.
error.invalid_key.title: Gemini didn't accept your API key
error.invalid_key.body: Check the key in Settings — paste it again from Google AI Studio.
error.rate_limited.title: Too many requests
error.rate_limited.body: You've reached your Gemini rate limit or daily quota. Wait a little and try again.
error.payment.title: Your Gemini credits ran out
error.payment.body: Add credits in your Google AI Studio account, then try again.
error.not_found.title: Model not found
error.not_found.body: The model may have been renamed or retired. Check the model IDs in Settings.
error.busy.title: Google's servers are busy right now
error.busy.body: This isn't a problem with your project. Wait a minute and try again — finished chapters are kept.
error.network.title: Can't reach Google
error.network.body: Check your internet connection and try again.
error.blocked.title: Gemini refused this request
error.blocked.body: Its safety filter blocked the content. Try rewording the topic.
error.bad_response.title: Gemini sent an unexpected answer
error.bad_response.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, try another text model in Settings.
error.cancelled.title: Stopped
error.other.title: Something went wrong
error.other.body: Try again. The details below can help if it keeps happening.
retry.invalid_reply: The answer from {model} had a problem — asking for a fix (step {attempt}/{max})…
settings.models.textChainHint: When Google is busy, each model gets 3 tries, then the next one in the list is used.
error.edge_unavailable.title: Edge TTS is unavailable
error.edge_unavailable.body: Microsoft's free voice service didn't answer or refused the request. It is unofficial and can stop working at any time. Switch to Gemini TTS in Settings → Voice, then try again.
error.suspicious_length.title: This voice may be cut off or repeated
error.suspicious_length.body: The audio is much shorter or longer than expected for this text. Listen to it and regenerate if it sounds wrong.
aspect.confirmBody: Every image, subtitle and clip will be regenerated for the new frame. Voices are kept.
scenes.cancelled: Voice generation stopped. Finished scenes are kept.
scenes.someFailed: {n} scene(s) need attention — check them below and regenerate.
settings.voice.title: Voice
settings.voice.body: Engine and voice for the narration. Edge TTS is free but unofficial — Microsoft can change or block it at any time. Gemini TTS uses your API key.
settings.voice.edgeHint: Speed and pitch apply to Edge TTS.
settings.voice.directionHint: For Gemini TTS, e.g. "calm, warm storyteller, medium pace".
settings.voice.changeNote: Changing the voice marks existing scene voices as outdated; they are regenerated on the next run.
settings.voice.voxcpmHint: Local voices run on your graphics card: free and offline. Install the model and make or choose a voice in “Local voices” below.
settings.images.title: Images
settings.images.body: Cloudflare Flux is free up to a daily allowance with your own Cloudflare account. Gemini image models need a Gemini key with billing.
settings.images.keySceneHint: Key scenes are the first scene, the first scene of each chapter and the last scene. You can use a better provider just for them.
settings.images.stepsHint: More steps look a little better but use more of the daily allowance (4 ≈ 170 images a day).
settings.images.geminiPaid: Gemini image models need billing. Switch to Cloudflare Flux if your key is on the free tier.
settings.images.changeNote: Changing the provider, model or steps marks existing images as outdated; they are regenerated on the next run.
settings.images.testOk: Cloudflare works — a test image was generated.
settings.images.tokenClearBody: You'll need to paste it again before generating images with Cloudflare.
look.title: Look & feel
look.empty.title: No look & feel yet
look.empty.body: The look & feel keeps every image in one style, with the same characters and places. It is written once from the script.
look.regenerateBody: Your edits here are replaced and all images become outdated.
look.intro: Written in English for the image model. Every image uses this style; scenes refer to characters and places by their key.
look.staleNote: Saving marks the images that change as outdated.
look.styleHint: Medium, light and colors, e.g. "warm watercolor storybook illustration, soft golden light".
look.charactersHint: One entry per recurring person: age, build, clothing, colors.
look.cultureHint: Clothing, architecture and details that keep the setting accurate.
look.seedHint: Part of each image's cache key: changing it makes all images outdated. Cloudflare Flux ignores it, so a re-run there gives a different picture.
script.keyScene: Key scene — its image is generated first.
images.title: Images
images.cancelled: Image generation stopped. Finished images are kept.
images.blockedHint: Edit the image prompt, then generate the image again.
images.estimate.upToDate: All images are up to date.
images.estimate.overDaily: This is more than one day's free allowance (~{n} images). Generation pauses when the limit is reached and resumes after the daily reset.
prompts.done: Image prompts improved: {n} changed. Generate images to see them.
prompts.confirmBody: Gemini rewrites the image prompt of all {n} scenes so each picture shows what its narration talks about, with more detail. The narration and voices stay the same. Images whose prompt changes become outdated and are made again when you generate images.
scenes.allReady: All voices and images are ready.
error.quota_daily.title: Daily free image limit reached
error.quota_daily.body: Progress is saved. Resume after the daily reset.
error.image_auth.title: The image service didn't accept your credentials
error.image_auth.body: Check the Cloudflare account ID and API token in Settings → Images (or billing for Gemini image models), then try again.
render.title: Video
render.lowPriority: Runs at low priority, so you can keep using the computer. Finished scenes are kept if you cancel.
render.cancelled: Rendering stopped. Finished scenes are kept.
render.notReady: Not ready yet: {voices} of {total} voices and {images} of {total} images are done.
settings.video.title: Video
settings.video.body: The H.264 encoder used to render. Hardware encoders (Intel, AMD, NVIDIA) are much faster; the app picks the first one that works.
error.ffmpeg_missing.title: FFmpeg is missing
error.ffmpeg_missing.body: The video tool that ships with the app was not found. Reinstall Nitean Studio.
error.ffmpeg.title: Rendering failed
error.ffmpeg.body: FFmpeg stopped with an error. Try again; if it keeps failing, choose "Software x264" in Settings → Video.
editor.trackerHint: Highlights each word while it is spoken.
editor.keys: Space: play / pause · ← →: previous / next scene · click the timeline to jump
look.presetHint: Changing the style rewrites the look & feel for it (characters and places are described to fit). Images become outdated and are generated again.
look.applyPresetBody: The look & feel is rewritten for this style and your edits to it are replaced. All images become outdated.
names.title: Names
names.intro: Names of products, brands and technologies (React Native, Android, iPhone …) are never translated: they stay in Latin letters in the subtitles, and the voice reads them in Khmer pronunciation. Add any other name that must stay exactly as written.
names.hint: Used when the script is written and when grammar is checked. Separate several names with commas.
proof.progress: Checking spelling, grammar and phrasing… {done} of {total} scenes
proof.cancelled: Grammar check stopped. Checked scenes keep their suggestions.
proof.nothingNew: Nothing changed since the last check.
proof.found: {n} suggested correction(s) — review them in the scenes marked in the list.
settings.images.localHint: Local GPU becomes available after you install a local model in Settings → Local images.
error.local_engine.title: The local image engine has a problem
error.local_engine.body: It could not start or it stopped. Close other heavy apps and try again, or switch to Cloudflare Flux in Settings → Images.
images.onBattery: Your laptop is on battery. Making many images on the GPU drains it quickly — plug in the charger first.
local.title: Local images
local.body: Make images on your own graphics card: free, no daily limit, works offline. Needs a GPU with at least 4 GB of memory and a one-time model download.
local.notCapable: Your GPU has less than 4 GB of memory, so images are made with Cloudflare.
local.engineMissing: The local image engine is missing from this installation. Reinstall Nitean Studio.
local.noProfiles: No local model is available yet — the model list is still being checked for quality and licences.
local.installed: Local model installed — images now use your GPU.
local.verifyBad: A file was damaged and removed. Install again to download it.
local.deleteBody: Frees {gb} GB. Images switch back to Cloudflare until you install a model again.
local.speed: ≈ {s} s per image on this computer
local.cooldownEvery: Pause after every N images (0 = off)
local.cooldownHint: Short pauses keep the GPU cooler during long runs.
local.cooldownLaptop: On laptops a pause of 20 s every 10 images keeps temperatures down.
local.offerTitle: Your GPU can make images for free
local.offerBody: No daily limit and no internet needed. Download the local model (~{gb} GB)?
voices.title: Local voices
voices.body: VoxCPM2 makes natural narration on your own graphics card — free, no limits, works offline. Make a voice from a description or from your own recording; it stays the same in every scene and project.
voices.notCapable: Local voices need a graphics card with at least {gb} GB of memory. Use Edge TTS or Gemini TTS instead.
voices.engineMissing: The local voice engine is missing from this installation. Reinstall Nitean Studio.
voices.installed: Voice model installed. Now make your first voice.
voices.empty: No voices yet. Make one from a description or from your own recording.
voices.deleteBody: Projects that use it switch to the default voice; their narration is made again on the next run.
voices.deleteModelBody: Frees about 2.8 GB. Your voices are kept, but local narration needs the model again (download).
voices.name: Name
voices.styleHint: In English, e.g. “calm, warm, medium pace”. Leave empty to keep the voice as recorded.
voices.cfgHint: Higher follows the voice and style more strictly; too high can sound strained. 2 is a good start.
voices.stepsHint: More steps sound slightly cleaner but take longer. 10 is a good balance.
voices.editNote: Changes mark the narration of projects with this voice as outdated.
voices.presetKhmerMaleDescription: Adult male Khmer documentary narrator with a warm, resonant mid-low voice and clear native Cambodian pronunciation. Calm and confident, natural medium pace, crisp articulation of Khmer words and technical terms. Suitable for history, science, and technology explainers. No exaggerated acting.
voices.presetKhmerFemaleDescription: Adult female Khmer documentary narrator with a warm, clear mid-range voice and natural native Cambodian pronunciation. Calm, confident, and engaging, at a natural medium pace with crisp articulation of Khmer words and technical terms. Suitable for history, science, and technology explainers. No exaggerated acting.
voices.descriptionPlaceholder: A warm, calm female narrator in her thirties, clear and friendly
voices.descriptionHint: In English: gender, age, character, pace. You get 3 samples to choose from.
voices.makingHint: The first time loads the model on your GPU; this can take a minute.
voices.recordingHint: 5–14 seconds of clear speech by one person, without music or noise. WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC or OGG.
voices.transcript: What is said in the recording (optional)
voices.transcriptHint: Typing the exact words makes the copy of the voice more faithful.
voices.consent: This is my own voice, or I have permission from the speaker to use it.
voices.consentNeeded: Only use your own voice or a voice you have permission to use.
wizard.mode.label: How to start
wizard.doc.label: PDF document
wizard.doc.limits: A paper, article or report up to 50 MB. Scanned pages, tables and Khmer text work.
wizard.doc.rangeHint: Choose pages inside the document, at most {max} pages.
wizard.doc.focusPlaceholder: e.g. explain only the results section
wizard.doc.freeTier: Free tier: Google may use uploaded content to improve its services. Don't upload private documents.
source.reading: Reading the document: {done} of {total} parts done
source.pausedDaily: The free daily Gemini limit is used up. Try again after {time}. The {done} of {total} parts already read are kept.
source.pausedMinute: Too many free-tier requests to Gemini right now. Try again after {time}. The {done} of {total} parts already read are kept.
source.readHint: Gemini reads the PDF and writes a summary. Nothing else is generated yet.
source.reviewHint: Tick the points the video should cover, put them in order and add notes. Nothing is generated until you confirm.
source.showNotes: Show what the document says on this page
source.notePlaceholder: A note for the script writer, e.g. “give an everyday example”
source.estimate: about {m} min of material for a {target}-min video
source.rereadBody: The summary, your ticks and your notes are replaced by a new reading. This uses your free Gemini requests again.
source.backTitle: Go back to the key points?
source.backBody: The script written from the current selection is removed, so it can be written again from your new choice.
source.generalKnowledge: General knowledge, not from the document
source.noPages: No page reference: check this scene
source.creditHint: Paste it into the video description.
settings.models.documentHint: Use a free-tier Flash model: in tests the Flash-Lite models got numbers and names wrong on scanned Khmer pages. Separate several models with commas.
settings.stock.title: Stock photos & videos
settings.stock.body: Real photos and clips for the "Real-world Tech Explainer" style. Wikimedia Commons and Openverse need no key. A Pixabay key adds stock videos and more photos.
settings.stock.sourceHint.commons: No key. Large photos; each file has its own license (CC0, public domain, CC BY).
settings.stock.sourceHint.openverse: No key. Flickr, museums and more; 200 searches a day (results are kept for 24 hours).
settings.stock.sourceHint.pixabay: Free key. Photos and videos; no credit required (we add one anyway).
settings.stock.sourceHint.pexels: Optional free key (Pexels may not be giving out new keys right now).
settings.stock.getKey.pixabay: Get a free Pixabay key (log in, then open the API docs)
settings.stock.testOk: The key works — a test search found {count} photos.
settings.stock.pixabayFull: With a normal Pixabay key, photos are at most 1280 px wide (marked "low-res" in 1080p videos). For full resolution, log in at pixabay.com, open the API docs and choose "Request full API access" (Support section). Pixabay reviews each account; there is no fixed waiting time.
settings.stock.bySaHint: Off by default. A video that crops or pans a CC BY-SA photo may count as an adaptation, and then the whole video would have to be shared under CC BY-SA too.
settings.stock.bySaWarn: CC BY-SA is on. Check the credits before you publish: your video may have to use the same license.
error.stock_no_key.title: No key for this source
error.stock_no_key.body: Add the key in Settings → Stock photos & videos, or use Wikimedia Commons and Openverse (no key needed).
error.stock_bad_key.title: The stock site didn't accept the key
error.stock_bad_key.body: Paste the key again from the site's API page (Settings → Stock photos & videos).
error.stock_rate_limited.title: Search limit reached
error.stock_rate_limited.body: This source asks us to wait. The other sources still work, and searches continue automatically after the reset.
error.stock_unavailable.title: Can't reach the stock site
error.stock_unavailable.body: Check your internet connection and try again.
error.stock_bad_response.title: The stock site sent an unexpected answer
error.stock_bad_response.body: Try again or search with other words.
error.stock_download.title: The file could not be downloaded
error.stock_download.body: Try again, or pick another photo or video.
visual.title: Scene {n} — picture
visual.searchPlaceholder: Search in English, e.g. submarine cable
visual.noResults: No results yet. Search with other words, or switch the type.
visual.licenceNote: Pexels / Pixabay: no recognisable people in a bad light, no implied endorsement, no logos or trademarks on products you sell.
visual.subject: Subject — click the picture to keep it in the frame
visual.subjectHint: The bright box is what the video shows; the shaded strip is where subtitles go.
visual.autoPicked: Chosen automatically — check that it fits the narration.
visual.mermaidHint: Starts with flowchart LR, flowchart TD, sequenceDiagram or timeline. Short labels in quotes.
visual.typeOut: Type it out line by line
visual.consent: This is my own screenshot or photo, or I have permission to use it.
visual.aiHint: The scene uses its image prompt and the image provider from Settings → Images (Generate images).
visual.paused: Every photo site asks us to wait. Searching continues after {time}.
visual.toCheck: {n} pictures were chosen automatically — open them to check (or keep them).
visual.fallback: No photo found ({why}); an AI image is used instead.
visual.creditsHint: Paste this into the video description.
error.stock_no_results.title: No photo found
error.stock_no_results.body: Search with other words in the scene's picture editor, or let the scene use an AI image.
